DATA-02.limitations: The forecasting data (speeds, weather, collisions, events, 311) were downloaded on the author's workstation; speed-links --since 2026-01-01 timed out server-side 6x, so the link set is 'active since 2026-09-20' (125 links citywide, 26 in Manhattan). On 2026-10-21 the development container reached NYC Open Data and re-downloaded the speed-link set (same 125 links; graph hash d8c69a468b82cbda reproduced), the Manhattan ATR counts 2009-2026 (per-year counts equal the server-side counts) and the West St OSM extract (OSM editing API; Overpass blocked).

PAPER-01.limitations: Results, discussion, limitations and conclusion (including the superseded SUMO comparison and the testbed audit) are written from the run artifacts and listed in paper_claims.csv; 26/26 references CHECKED. Author block filled with the student (S K Sricharan, VIT Chennai); co-authors and author order (e.g. the guide) are to be confirmed by the authors before submission.

SIM-02.limitations: Corrected comparison RUN on 2026-10-28 (workstation) on the protocol v6 calibrated plan (90 s cycle, green factor 1.5, 25 mph offsets; 10.08 vs 10.95 mph observed): 45 runs, 0 teleports, seeds 1-5 matched. The matched pair is fixed-time vs forecast rule (same plan, network, seeds); the actuated controller runs on netconvert's actuated programs (signal_timing netconvert_guess), so it is an uncalibrated reference and is not ranked. PARTIAL because of that, because side-street demand is 0 (the only admissible level) and because the stress scenarios leave 340-540 trips unfinished under both matched controllers. The 2026-10-20 runs are SUPERSEDED (kept in progress.md). SIMULATED results on a calibrated scenario testbed, never a real-world gain.
